limitations: The audit used source text for all 124 lesson PDFs and visually inspected seven targeted pages; it is not a certification of every printed page.

The remaining grammar summaries need field-by-field provenance review before treating every meaningZh as a separately printed school translation. Existing school explanations and source wording were not guessed or silently rewritten.
